fields.name: ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence<TShardOptions> grain-storage operations
fields.contract: For a grain type, grain identity, and grain-state envelope, ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence<TShardOptions> provides read, write, and clear persistence operations. Read selects the grain's configured query contract, derives its shard identifier, and maps the configured read result into the supplied state. Write derives the shard identifier from the grain identity and state, executes the configured write query with mapped input parameters, and marks the record as existing. Clear derives the shard identifier and clear parameters, executes the configured clear query, and marks the record as not existing.
